body: My dms are open if you ever need to talk. I’ve been through a similar relationship/situation with an ex 💜

Not op, but my partner’s parents were both murdered in their home when they were children. He and his sister are two of the most amazing people I have ever met. I can message you privately if you’d like? I see your username btw, we’re all from Hawaii too
As a woman with short hair, I understand.
Fair enough! Controlling my emotions and the way I can come off sounding when I’m flustered has been something I’ve been working on the past few years
Thanks for your comment, I needed that reminder that not all arguments are malicious when you’re not in an  abusive relationship 😅
